title: SETTINGS PANE HINT ENDS CLEANLY
why: Critic on Settings 18 (P0): the shortened pane text stopped mid-sentence with no mark. The first clause now stays whole up to 90 characters and a longer one ends in an ellipsis.
now: The Settings pane hint never stops mid-sentence.

edits.anchor: function setHintShort(t){ var s=String(t||'').split(/[:;]|\. | \(/)[0].trim(); if(s.length>56){ s=s.slice(0,56); s=s.slice(0,Math.max(s.lastIndexOf(' '),1)); } return s; }
edits.replacement: function setHintShort(t){ var s=String(t||'').split(/[:;]|\. | \(/)[0].trim(); if(s.length>90){ s=s.slice(0,88); s=s.slice(0,Math.max(s.lastIndexOf(' '),1))+'\u2026'; } return s; }   // v34.37 (cw-setscroll3): critic on Settings 18 (P0): the pane text stopped mid-sentence with no mark. The first clause stays whole up to 90 characters, longer ones end in an ellipsis.
